title: 2. Localize frozen JOINT's reset weakness without another rollout
hypothesis: Expanded resets expose a transverse-position capture-basin boundary, so initial displacement perpendicular to the pen axis predicts frozen JOINT failure beyond axial displacement and tilt.

prediction.against: R-129: frozen JOINT on the lowest transverse-displacement quartile of expanded resets
prediction.rationale: Compare highest versus lowest transverse-displacement quartiles, standardized over predeclared axial-displacement and tilt tertiles on common support. A 0.15 success deficit would localize a substantial part of D-089's 0.281 reset penalty. D-092 tested training-distribution coverage, not this geometric localization; this is descriptive robustness analysis, not authorization for capture-controller development.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && timeout 900s python -u scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --study reset_geometry_audit'
code_changes: lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/reset_geometry_audit.py (new, archive only; registered in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py with a block in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml). Primary archive: R-129's 512 frozen-JOINT cases under reset scale 1.5 (logs/pen_spin/r129_frozen_robustness/cells/s<seed>/joint@reset_1.5_cell.json, 4 manifests). Separate replication, never pooled and never chosen between after results: R-133's 1,536 frozen-JOINT cases under reset scale 1.5 (logs/pen_spin/r133_reset_mixture/confirmation/expanded/s<seed>/joint_cell.json, 12 manifests).

Initial states are reconstructed, not recorded: a case's reset is cases.resolve_placements(manifest) times the recorded reset scale (position offset = rows 0-2 times the env's position noise; tilt = the rotation built from rows 3-4 as the runner writes it). Frozen definitions: the initial pen long axis is the tilted x axis; axial displacement = |offset . axis|; transverse displacement = norm of the offset perpendicular to the axis; tilt = the initial rotation angle. Within each archive: transverse quartiles, axial tertiles and tilt tertiles by rank (ties by case order).

Registered quantity (success_rate): sustained success in the highest transverse quartile minus the lowest, standardized over the axial-by-tilt strata present in both extreme quartiles with weights proportional to the pooled count of the two quartiles in each stratum; a case-level 95% interval from the per-stratum binomial variances. Report support counts and the coverage of the common support (at least 6 of 9 strata and 60% of both quartiles' cases, otherwise inconclusive). Supported (a decrease of at least 0.15) with the upper bound <= -0.15; refuted with the lower bound > -0.15; otherwise inconclusive. Also report unstandardized success by quartile for transverse, axial and tilt.
Ceiling: 0 simulator episodes, 0 LLM calls, 15 minutes; no new seeds, manifests, fitting or replacement rollouts; reconstruction failures are reported, not patched.

falsified_by: The lower 95% interval bound on high-minus-low standardized success is above -0.15. Failure of common support or unavailable initial-state records makes the audit inconclusive rather than permitting replacement rollouts.

approval.note: I accept the corrected study entry point, reconstructed initial geometry and separately reported R-133 replication; this localizes frozen JOINT's reset weakness descriptively rather than repeating D-092's training intervention. Its weakest point remains sparse common support, and neither association

direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial-rolling research from the frozen R-121 JOINT controller. Prioritize independent training reproducibility, then robustness of frozen controllers. Reproduce the successful residual-plus-recovery construction across independent training seeds before claiming a reliable learning algorithm. Evaluate longer horizons and predeclared physical/reset perturbations without fitting. Use archived failures to decide whether recovery hand-back deserves a state-dependent transition study. Then investigate whether LLM-guided construction can discover useful recovery-module structure against grammar search and the hand-designed template under matched budgets. Preserve the original six-second task and evaluation contract. Use JOINT as the experimental reference, preserve all existing assets, and leave default-incumbent installation separate. Run one protocol at a time through the existing advisor/implementer loop. Continue justified follow-ups within this direction; honor its escalation and exhaustion rules. No new global budget ceiling is imposed; each protocol must declare finite simulator, wall-time and model-call costs before agreement. No controller-generation calls for Q1–Q3. Q4 requires a separately agreed generation budget. Advisor calls for the research loop remain permitted throughout.

advisor.reasoning: This can localize frozen JOINT's reset vulnerability descriptively without repeating D-092's training-coverage intervention or authorizing capture-controller development. Its weakest point is potentially sparse common support after quartiling and stratification, which may leave the geometric comparison inconclusive. falsified_by: the lower 95% interval bound on standardized highest-minus-lowest transverse-quartile success exceeds -0.15. The finite cost is 0 simulator episodes, 0 LLM calls and 15 minutes using the existing summarizer and frozen JOINT reference.

implementer.reasoning: Worth doing at zero episodes: it localizes D-089's weakness descriptively. Two corrections. (1) Entry point, as for R-134: scripts/summarise_experiments.py summarises MetaWorld experiment records and has no such mode; use scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --study reset_geometry_audit with config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml and a module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/reset_geometry_audit.py, run on the box where the cells are. Initial states are not recorded in cells but are exactly reconstructable: a case's reset is its manifest placement vector times the reset scale (cases.resolve_placements; position offset rows 0-2, tilt rows 3-4), and R-133's smoke verified the written offsets to 1.5e-6. (2) Data: R-129 has only 512 JOINT cases at 1.5x (4 manifests), too few for 4 quartiles x 9 strata. D-092's archive adds 1,536 fresh frozen-JOINT cases at 1.5x (12 manifests). Register R-129's 512 as the named source and R-133's 1,536 as a predeclared replication reported beside it, with the same frozen definitions: transverse displacement = the component of the initial position offset perpendicular to the pen's initial long axis, axial = the component along it, tilt = the initial rotation magnitude; quartiles and tertiles computed within each archive; standardization over the axial x tilt strata present in both extreme quartiles.

advisor.reasoning: I accept both implementer corrections: the MetaWorld summarizer is unsuitable, and R-133 supplies a useful separately reported archive replication without new rollouts. Reconstructing initial geometry from manifest placements is appropriate, but sparse common support remains the weakest point, especially for R-129's four manifests. This can describe reset vulnerability after R-134, not establish a causal capture boundary or authorize controller development.
suggested_changes: Use scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py with config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml and a new lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/reset_geometry_audit.py module. Run via gpu run with ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh sourced and a 900-second timeout.

Register R-129's 512 frozen-JOINT expanded-reset cases as primary and R-133's 1,536 frozen-JOINT expanded-reset cases as a separate replication; do not pool them or select between them after seeing results.

Reconstruct offsets using cases.resolve_placements and the recorded reset scale. Define transverse and axial displacement relative to the initial pen long axis and tilt as initial rotation magnitude; freeze within-archive quartile/tertile boundaries, tie handling and common-support weights before outcome comparisons.

Retain prediction: success_rate decreases by at least 0.15 in the highest transverse-displacement quartile versus frozen JOINT in the lowest quartile, standardized over shared axial-by-tilt strata within each archive. Report support counts and coverage; falsified_by: lower 95% bound on high-minus-low success above -0.15, while threshold-crossing intervals or inadequate common support are inconclusive and zero-crossing intervals provide no directional evidence.

Retain the finite ceiling of 0 simulator episodes, 0 LLM calls and 15 minutes runtime, with no new seeds, manifests, fitting or replacement rollouts; report reconstruction failures rather than substituting data.

implementer.reasoning: Agreed: the advisor's round-2 list is my corrections (study-module entry point, archive sources, frozen definitions) with the inference limits stated; I apply it as written.
